item.title: NFS Deployment and Mounting
item.description: NFS (Network File System) is used to share directories over the network; once the client mounts them, they can be read and written like a local disk. This post covers deploying an NFS service on CentOS and Ubuntu, and how to mount a remote NFS directory on each system. 1.
